Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: A natural person employed by the organisation. Carries the identity, payroll, and wage-tax attributes the payroll/wage-tax compliance checks read (BSN, tax table colour, ID-document retention, 30%-ruling, A1 posting, minimum-wage basis).

bsn.title: BSN
bsn.description: Dutch citizen service number. Without it, payroll has to apply the anonymous rate.
bsn.x-notes: Burgerservicenummer (NL tax identification). Presence drives the anoniementarief check (nl-anoniementarief).

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: When employment ends. Leave empty while the employee is still with you.
endDate.x-notes: Employment end date, or null while active.

grossMonthlySalary.title: Gross monthly salary
grossMonthlySalary.description: Gross monthly salary in the pay currency.

taxTableColor.title: Tax table color
taxTableColor.description: Which payroll-tax table applies: the white table for current employment, the green table for a pension or benefit.
taxTableColor.x-notes: Loonheffing tax table colour (wit = current employment, groen = pensions/benefits). Drives the combined loonheffing/volksverzekeringen levy (nl-loonheffingen-volksverzekeringen).

identityDocumentVerified.title: Identity document verified
identityDocumentVerified.description: Tick this once you have checked the employee's ID and filed a copy with the payroll records.
identityDocumentVerified.x-notes: Whether a valid identity document was verified and copied into the loonadministratie (nl-id-bewaarplicht-5jaar).

identityDocumentRetainedUntil.title: Identity document retained until
identityDocumentRetainedUntil.description: How long the copy of the ID must be kept — at least five years after the year employment ends.
identityDocumentRetainedUntil.x-notes: Date until which the ID-document copy is retained — at least 5 years after the year employment ends (nl-id-bewaarplicht-5jaar).

loonheffingenVerklaringOnFile.title: Payroll tax statement on file
loonheffingenVerklaringOnFile.description: Whether the employee's loonheffingenverklaring (wage-tax statement) is on file.

elstamRetrieved.title: Elstam retrieved
elstamRetrieved.description: Germany: the electronic wage-tax details have been retrieved from ELStAM.
elstamRetrieved.x-notes: DE: whether the ELStAM electronic wage-tax features were retrieved (de-elstam-abruf).

steuerklasse.title: Steuerklasse
steuerklasse.description: Germany: the wage-tax class (I–VI) taken from ELStAM.
steuerklasse.x-notes: DE: Lohnsteuer tax class (Steuerklasse I-VI) applied from ELStAM (de-elstam-abruf).

w4OnFile.title: W4 on file
w4OnFile.description: United States: a Form W-4 is on file for this employee.
w4OnFile.x-notes: US: whether a Form W-4 is on file for the employee (us-w4-on-file).

i9VerifiedWithinThreeDays.title: I9 verified within three days
i9VerifiedWithinThreeDays.description: United States: work eligibility was verified on Form I-9 within three business days of the start date.
i9VerifiedWithinThreeDays.x-notes: US: whether work eligibility was verified on Form I-9 within 3 business days of start (us-i9-verification).

newHireReportedDate.title: New hire reported date
newHireReportedDate.description: United States: the date this hire was reported to the state Directory of New Hires.
newHireReportedDate.x-notes: US: date the new hire was reported to the state Directory of New Hires (us-new-hire-reporting).

a1CertificateNumber.title: A1 certificate number
a1CertificateNumber.description: EU: the A1 certificate number, for an employee posted to another member state.
a1CertificateNumber.x-notes: EU: A1 posted-worker certificate number, when the employee is posted (eu-a1-posted-worker).

a1ValidUntil.title: A1 valid until
a1ValidUntil.description: EU: when the A1 certificate expires — at most 24 months after the posting starts.
a1ValidUntil.x-notes: EU: A1 certificate expiry — max 24 months after posting start (eu-a1-posted-worker).

postedWorker.title: Posted worker
postedWorker.description: EU: this employee works in another member state but stays insured at home.
postedWorker.x-notes: EU: whether the employee is posted to another member state remaining home-insured (eu-a1-posted-worker).

thirtyPercentRulingGranted.title: 30%-ruling granted
thirtyPercentRulingGranted.description: The tax office has granted the 30% expat ruling. Payroll then leaves up to 30% of the gross salary untaxed.
thirtyPercentRulingGranted.x-notes: NL: whether a 30%-beschikking (expatregeling, Wet LB 1964 art. 31a) has been granted. When true, PayrollRunService feeds thirtyPercentRulingRate into the payroll engine, which exempts up to that percentage of the (capped) gross from the taxable wage (30-procent-regeling / nl-30-percent-regeling / nl-30-regeling-aftoppingsgrens).

thirtyPercentRulingRate.title: 30%-ruling applied rate
thirtyPercentRulingRate.description: The percentage payroll actually applies. 30 for a 2025 or 2026 grant; it may not be higher.
thirtyPercentRulingRate.x-notes: NL: the engine-consumed applied 30%-ruling percentage (flat, not stepped — the Belastingplan 2024 30/20/10 step-down was reversed before taking effect). 30 for a 2025/2026 grant; must not exceed 30 for 2025-2026 (nl-30-percent-regeling). Only consumed when thirtyPercentRulingGranted is true (30-procent-regeling).

thirtyPercentCappedAtWntNorm.title: 30%-ruling capped at WNT-norm
thirtyPercentCappedAtWntNorm.description: The tax-free part is capped at the WNT ceiling (€262,000 a year in 2026). This applies to every ruling from 1 January 2026.
thirtyPercentCappedAtWntNorm.x-notes: NL: whether the 30%-ruling tax-free base is capped at the WNT-aftoppingsgrens (€262.000/jaar in 2026). Unconditional for every 30%-ruling from 1 Jan 2026 (nl-30-regeling-aftoppingsgrens).

thirtyPercentRulingStartDate.title: 30%-ruling start date
thirtyPercentRulingStartDate.description: When the ruling takes effect. The five-year maximum term is counted from this date.
thirtyPercentRulingStartDate.x-notes: NL: the beschikking's ingangsdatum (ISO 8601), or null. Anchors the 60-month maximum term; read by nl-30-regeling-looptijd-5jaar (30-procent-regeling).

thirtyPercentRulingEndDate.title: 30%-ruling end date
thirtyPercentRulingEndDate.description: When the ruling ends. Flagged if it is missing, more than 60 months after the start date, or already past.
thirtyPercentRulingEndDate.x-notes: NL: the beschikking's einddatum (ISO 8601), or null. Flagged by nl-30-regeling-looptijd-5jaar when absent, more than 60 months after the start date, or already in the past while the ruling is still granted (30-procent-regeling).

thirtyPercentRulingReducedNormApplies.title: 30%-ruling reduced salary norm applies
thirtyPercentRulingReducedNormApplies.description: The lower salary threshold applies — under 30 with a qualifying master's: €36,497 in 2026 instead of €48,013.
thirtyPercentRulingReducedNormApplies.x-notes: NL: whether the under-30-with-qualifying-master's reduced salary norm (€36.497 in 2026, versus the €48.013 general norm) applies to this employee. Gates which norm nl-30-regeling-salarisnorm compares the annualised salary against (30-procent-regeling).

nextcloudUserId.title: Nextcloud user ID
nextcloudUserId.description: The employee's own Nextcloud account, so they can see their hours, payslips and leave. Leave empty for external staff who only use the portal.
nextcloudUserId.x-notes: The Nextcloud user id of this employee's own account, when they have one (mijn-hr-self-service). HR-maintained on the employee record; stays null for portal-only external employees, who keep using the UUID-claim-based portaliq scoping (ADR-046 A4). The durable Employee<->account link; per-record `userId` on Timesheet/Expense/LeaveRequest/Payslip is a denormalized copy of it.

iban.title: IBAN
iban.description: Bank account for the salary payment. Without it, the employee cannot be included in a payment batch.
iban.x-notes: Bank account IBAN for net-pay SEPA credit transfers (payroll-sepa-netpay-shillinq). Shape check only — mod-97 checksum is a non-goal. Missing IBAN on a payable payroll run's payslip fails the net-pay batch closed (nl-netpay-iban-present).

tenaamstelling.title: Account holder
tenaamstelling.description: Account holder's name as the bank knows it. Left empty, the employee's first and last name are used.
tenaamstelling.x-notes: Account-holder name as the bank knows it (payroll-sepa-netpay-shillinq) — printed as Cdtr/Nm on the SEPA credit transfer. Falls back to firstName + lastName when absent.

loonheffingskortingToegepast.title: Payroll tax credit applied
loonheffingskortingToegepast.description: The employee asked this employer to apply the payroll tax credit. Only one employer may apply it at a time.
loonheffingskortingToegepast.x-notes: Whether the employee elected on the loonbelastingverklaring to have the loonheffingskorting (heffingskortingen) applied by this employer (Rekenvoorschriften 2026 §2.2.3; drives the AHK/ARK application in the payroll engine — payroll-core-engine). Apply with at most one employer at a time; loonheffingenVerklaringOnFile records that the statement itself is archived.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: Which administration this employee belongs to.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this Employee is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun convention): the manifest filter grammar cannot reach cross-schema relations, so this is maintained by HR/back-office when the record is created; the implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it and nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007) audits every Employee-anchored child record against it.

isDga.title: Is dga
isDga.description: This employee is a director-major-shareholder, and so is not insured under the employee insurance schemes.
isDga.x-notes: NL: whether this employee is a DGA (directeur-grootaandeelhouder, director-major-shareholder/aanmerkelijkbelanghouder) -- not verzekeringsplichtig for the werknemersverzekeringen (dga-payroll-mode). A mode-switch on this record (ADR-001 Rule 4), never a separate app/schema: drives CalculationInput.verzekeringsplichtig via PayrollRunService and is the nl-gebruikelijkloon-norm check's scope gate.

gebruikelijkloonJustification.title: Customary-wage justification
gebruikelijkloonJustification.description: Why the salary is below the statutory minimum for a director-major-shareholder. Give one of the three legal grounds.
gebruikelijkloonJustification.x-notes: NL: free-text justification for a below-gebruikelijkloon-norm salary (dga-payroll-mode) -- one of the three statutory grounds (comparable-function salary, highest-paid-employee salary, or a lower amount substantiated to the Belastingdienst). MVP: presence-only exemption from nl-gebruikelijkloon-norm; content is not validated (named follow-up). Only meaningful when isDga is true.

publicSectorRegime.title: Public sector regime
publicSectorRegime.description: The civil-service regime this employee falls under, if any. Leave empty for ordinary private-sector staff.
publicSectorRegime.x-notes: NL: whether this employee is a public-sector ambtenaar and under which legal regime (aor-ambtenarenrecht). A mode-switch on this record (ADR-001 Rule 4), the isDga precedent, never a separate app/schema. 'genormaliseerd' = a Wnra-normalized ambtenaar on an ordinary BW7 arbeidsovereenkomst; 'ambtenarenwet' = still on the Ambtenarenwet 2017 public-law footing (politie, defensie, rechterlijke macht, political office-holders). null = an ordinary private-sector employee, for whom ambtseedAfgelegdOp and nevenwerkzaamhedenGemeld carry no compliance meaning. HR-set, never derived from a sector/function taxonomy (none exists in humaniq today); scopes the nl-ambtenaar-eed-vereist and nl-ambtenaar-nevenwerkzaamheden-melding checks.

ambtseedAfgelegdOp.title: Oath of office sworn on
ambtseedAfgelegdOp.description: The date the oath or affirmation of office was taken. Only relevant for civil servants.
ambtseedAfgelegdOp.x-notes: NL: the date the ambtseed/-belofte (oath or affirmation of office) was taken (Ambtenarenwet 2017 art. 5, aor-ambtenarenrecht). Only meaningful when publicSectorRegime is non-null; presence gates the nl-ambtenaar-eed-vereist check (presence-only, the ceremony's content is never validated).

nevenwerkzaamhedenGemeld.title: Secondary employment reported
nevenwerkzaamhedenGemeld.description: The employee has declared any side activities that could affect their duties. Only relevant for civil servants.
nevenwerkzaamhedenGemeld.x-notes: NL: whether the nevenwerkzaamheden integrity-disclosure attestation (disclosure of side activities that could affect proper performance of duty or public trust) is on file (Ambtenarenwet 2017 art. 9, aor-ambtenarenrecht). Only meaningful when publicSectorRegime is non-null; gates the nl-ambtenaar-nevenwerkzaamheden-melding check (presence-only attestation, the disclosed content is never validated).

wntTopfunctionaris.title: WNT senior official
wntTopfunctionaris.description: This employee is a senior official under the Senior Public Sector Executives Act (WNT).
wntTopfunctionaris.x-notes: NL: whether this employee is a topfunctionaris under the Wet normering topinkomens (WNT, BWBR0032249) -- a board member or director who leads the whole (semi-)public organisation. A mode-switch on this record (ADR-001 Rule 4, the isDga precedent), never derived from a function/sector taxonomy (none exists in humaniq today). Gates the nl-wnt-norm-overschrijding check via the annual WntDisclosure; carries no compliance meaning when false (wnt-disclosure).

wntUitzonderingReden.title: WNT exemption ground
wntUitzonderingReden.description: Why this senior official may earn above the WNT ceiling. Leave empty when no exemption applies.
wntUitzonderingReden.x-notes: NL: the recorded transitional-exemption ground for a topfunctionaris whose bezoldiging exceeds the WNT-norm -- 'overgangsrecht' (WNT art. 2.7 transitional protection for a contract predating a norm reduction) or 'ontheffing-minister' (a ministerial ontheffing). null = no exemption recorded. Presence-only gate (the ground's substantive correctness is never validated, wnt-disclosure design.md D4); only meaningful when wntTopfunctionaris is true. A non-null value clears the nl-wnt-norm-overschrijding check.

EmploymentContract.title: Employment Contract
EmploymentContract.description: An employment agreement between the organisation and an employee. Carries the contract attributes the payroll checks read (permanent/temporary type that drives the Awf low/high premium, contracted hours, CAO, minimum-wage hourly basis).

employeeId.title: Employee ID
employeeId.x-notes: Reference to the Employee this contract belongs to.

type.title: Contract type
type.description: The kind of contract. This drives the unemployment-fund rate, and for an apprenticeship how the pay is processed.
type.x-notes: Contract type. 'permanent' (written, indefinite) takes the Awf low tariff; flexible/temporary/agency/minijob take the high tariff (nl-awf-laag-hoog-tarief). 'bbl' (MBO-BBL leerarbeidsovereenkomst, stagiair-bbl-admin): a BBL-leerling has a real arbeidsovereenkomst and is loonheffingplichtig as an ordinary werknemer (loon, loonheffing, premies, CAO-toepassing all apply), per the Belastingdienst Handboek Loonheffingen (hoofdstuk 17, 'Stagiairs') -- so a bbl contract flows through PayrollCalculator and the NL jurisdiction pack exactly like a permanent/temporary contract, with NO type-specific branch (design.md D1/D2). Takes the Awf high tariff (not permanent). A person on a stageovereenkomst zonder dienstverband (HBO/WO/MBO-BOL) is NOT a bbl contract -- it is a separate Stagiair schema, structurally outside payroll.

writtenContract.title: Written contract
writtenContract.description: There is a signed written contract. Required for the low unemployment-fund rate.
writtenContract.x-notes: Whether the contract is in writing — a precondition for the Awf low tariff (nl-awf-laag-hoog-tarief).

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: When this contract ends. Leave empty for an indefinite contract.
endDate.x-notes: Contract end date, or null for indefinite.

hoursPerWeek.title: Hours per week
hoursPerWeek.description: Contracted hours per week. Used to work out the minimum pay for each period.
hoursPerWeek.x-notes: Contracted hours per week. Used with the statutory hourly minimum to derive period minimums (nl-minimumuurloon-wet).

hourlyWage.title: Hourly wage
hourlyWage.description: Gross hourly wage. It must be at least the statutory minimum.
hourlyWage.x-notes: Gross hourly wage. Must meet the statutory minimum hourly wage (nl-minimumloon-2026 / nl-minimumuurloon-wet / de-mindestlohn-2026 / fr-smic-2026 / us-flsa-minimum-wage).

cao.title: Collective labour agreement
cao.description: The collective labour agreement this contract follows. Leave empty when none applies.
cao.x-notes: Applicable collective labour agreement: the id of a CAO in the maintained library (lib/Standards/cao/{cao}.json, e.g. cao-generiek / cao-metaal-techniek / cao-horeca), resolvable through CaoRegistry. Null when the contract follows no CAO. Drives the below-CAO-minimum audit checks (nl-cao-minimumloon-schaal on this contract's salary, nl-cao-verlof-minimum on the employee's leave).

caoSchaal.title: Collective agreement scale
caoSchaal.description: The pay scale within that collective agreement, for example 'A' or 'II'.
caoSchaal.x-notes: The pay scale (schaal) within the referenced CAO's loontabel (e.g. 'A', 'B', 'II') that this contract is paid on. Null when no scale is set — the pay-scale check (nl-cao-minimumloon-schaal) is then vacuous. Only meaningful together with a non-null cao.

normfunctieId.title: Reference job ID
normfunctieId.description: The reference job assigned to this contract. Set it by hand; it is never derived.
normfunctieId.x-notes: The HR21 normfunctie (functiehuis-hr21) assigned to this contract, HR-set directly -- never derived or computed, mirroring how cao/caoSchaal are set. Null when no normfunctie is assigned. Read by nl-hr21-schaal-consistentie: when the resolved Normfunctie's caoSchaalVerified is true, this contract's own caoSchaal must equal the normfunctie's caoSchaal.

awfTariff.title: Awf tariff
awfTariff.description: The unemployment-fund rate applied: low for a permanent written contract, high otherwise.
awfTariff.x-notes: Applied Awf (unemployment fund) tariff — low for permanent written contracts, high otherwise (nl-awf-laag-hoog-tarief).

workingTimeDocumented.title: Working time documented
workingTimeDocumented.description: Germany: daily working time is recorded within seven days and kept for at least two years.
workingTimeDocumented.x-notes: DE: whether daily working time is recorded within 7 days and retained ≥2 years for §17 MiLoG sectors/Minijobs (de-mindestlohn-arbeitszeit-doku).

overtimeMultiplier.title: Overtime multiplier
overtimeMultiplier.description: United States: the overtime rate for hours over 40 a week. At least 1.5.
overtimeMultiplier.x-notes: US: overtime pay multiplier for hours over 40/week for non-exempt employees — must be ≥1.5 (us-flsa-overtime).

ftePartOfYearMinijob.title: Fte part of year minijob
ftePartOfYearMinijob.description: Germany: this is a Minijob within the small-earnings threshold, using flat-rate contributions.
ftePartOfYearMinijob.x-notes: DE: whether the contract is a Minijob within the geringfügige Beschäftigung threshold using flat-rate contributions (de-minijob-pauschale).

dpaeFiledBeforeStart.title: Dpae filed before start
dpaeFiledBeforeStart.description: France: the pre-employment declaration (DPAE) was filed in the eight days before the start date.
dpaeFiledBeforeStart.x-notes: FR: whether the Déclaration Préalable À l'Embauche (DPAE) was filed in the 8 days before the hire (fr-dpae).

aanzegdOn.title: Non-renewal notice given on
aanzegdOn.description: The date you told the employee in writing whether a fixed-term contract will continue. Due at least one month before the end date.
aanzegdOn.x-notes: NL: date the written aanzegging (BW 7:668 lid 1) was sent to the employee, informing whether a fixed-term contract of six months or longer will be continued. Must be on or before endDate minus one month to satisfy nl-aanzegtermijn-bewaking.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: Which administration this contract belongs to. Normally the same as the employee's.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this EmploymentContract is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun convention), mirroring its owning Employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007).

bpvOvereenkomstOndertekend.title: Placement agreement signed
bpvOvereenkomstOndertekend.description: The three-party work-placement agreement has been signed. Tick this by hand once signing is done.
bpvOvereenkomstOndertekend.x-notes: NL: for a type: bbl contract (stagiair-bbl-admin), whether the (three-party) BPV-/praktijkleerovereenkomst is signed -- marked manually by HR after paper or externally-handled signing is complete, the writtenContract convention, NOT an automated e-signature flow (offer-esign design.md point 4, design.md D3). The BBL counterpart of Stagiair.bpvOvereenkomstOndertekend. Gates the type: bbl branch of nl-bpv-overeenkomst-vereist: must be true once startDate has passed. Null/absent for every non-bbl contract type (the rule is vacuous for them, design.md D4).

bpvSchoolNaam.title: Vocational placement school
bpvSchoolNaam.description: The school that is party to the work-placement agreement.
bpvSchoolNaam.x-notes: NL: for a type: bbl contract, the name of the onderwijsinstelling (ROC/vakschool) party to the BPV-/praktijkleerovereenkomst. Informational; null/absent for every non-bbl contract type.

uitzendFase.title: Agency phase
uitzendFase.description: The agency phase (A, B or C) of this temporary-work contract. Only for agency contracts; set it by hand.
uitzendFase.x-notes: NL: de ABU/NBBU-fasensysteemfase (A/B/C) van deze uitzendovereenkomst -- alleen zinvol op een uitzendcontract (type 'agency'). Door HR ingevoerd, niet afgeleid uit een gewerkte-weken-telling (uitzend-flexpool D2). Fase A is de flexibele beginfase waarin het uitzendbeding (uitzendbedingVanToepassing) rechtsgeldig kan gelden (BW art. 7:691 lid 2); in fase B/C geldt het uitzendbeding niet meer. Gelezen door nl-uitzendbeding-alleen-fase-a. Null wanneer geen fase is vastgelegd.

uitzendbedingVanToepassing.title: Agency clause applies
uitzendbedingVanToepassing.description: The agency clause applies, so the contract ends by law as soon as the hirer ends the placement. Only possible in phase A.
uitzendbedingVanToepassing.x-notes: NL: of het uitzendbeding (BW art. 7:691 lid 2) op deze uitzendovereenkomst van toepassing is -- het beding dat de uitzendovereenkomst van rechtswege doet eindigen zodra de inlener de terbeschikkingstelling beeindigt. Door HR ingevoerd, alleen zinvol op een uitzendcontract (type 'agency'). Is dit true, dan moet uitzendFase gelijk zijn aan A (nl-uitzendbeding-alleen-fase-a); het beding is juridisch niet houdbaar zodra de kracht fase A voorbij is. Null wanneer niet vastgelegd.

inlenersbeloningReferentie.title: Hirer's pay reference
inlenersbeloningReferentie.description: Note how the hourly wage was matched to what a comparable employee at the hirer would earn.
inlenersbeloningReferentie.x-notes: NL: vrije-tekstverwijzing naar de onderbouwing van het uurloon tegen de inlenersbeloning -- de beloning die een vergelijkbare werknemer in een gelijke functie bij de inlener zou ontvangen (WAADI art. 8). Een audittrail-veld (dezelfde vertrouwensgrens als Loonbeslag.beslagvrijeVoet), geen berekende handhaving: alleen de aanwezigheid wordt getoetst, niet de juistheid van het bedrag. Op een uitzendcontract (type 'agency') met een ingevuld hourlyWage moet dit veld gevuld zijn (nl-inlenersbeloning-onderbouwing-vereist). Null wanneer geen onderbouwing is vastgelegd.

Payslip.title: Payslip
Payslip.description: A per-employee, per-period wage statement (loonstrook / Lohnabrechnung / bulletin de paie / pay stub). Carries the gross-to-net composition the payroll-withholding, social-security, and statutory-content checks read.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The Nextcloud account this payslip is shown to. Set by payroll; employees never fill this in themselves.
userId.x-notes: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee this payslip belongs to (mijn-hr-self-service). Plain NC-user-id string, never a $ref — mirrors the approvedBy convention on Timesheet/Expense. Employees never author their own payslip, so this is set by payroll alongside employeeId when the payslip is generated; the read-only MijnLoonstroken self-service page filters on it with the @me token.

period.title: Period
period.description: Wage period in YYYY-MM (or YYYY-Pnn for four-weekly).

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: Which country's payroll rules apply to this payslip.
jurisdiction.x-notes: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose payroll rules govern this payslip (NL/DE/FR/US).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency the pay is in, for example EUR.

grossPay.title: Gross pay
grossPay.x-notes: Gross wage for the period (BR for loonstrook content).

hoursWorked.title: Hours worked
hoursWorked.description: Hours worked in the period. Together with the gross pay this gives the effective hourly rate the minimum-wage check uses.
hoursWorked.x-notes: Hours worked in the period; with grossPay yields the effective hourly rate for minimum-wage checks.

loonheffing.title: Loonheffing
loonheffing.description: Payroll tax withheld this period: wage tax plus national insurance contributions.
loonheffing.x-notes: NL: combined loonheffing (loonbelasting + premie volksverzekeringen) withheld (nl-loonheffingen-inhouding / nl-loonheffingen-volksverzekeringen).

volksverzekeringen.title: Volksverzekeringen
volksverzekeringen.description: The national insurance part of the payroll tax withheld.
volksverzekeringen.x-notes: NL: premie volksverzekeringen portion within the loonheffing (nl-loonheffingen-volksverzekeringen).

werknemersverzekeringen.title: Werknemersverzekeringen
werknemersverzekeringen.description: Employee insurance contributions paid by the employer. Zero for a director-major-shareholder.
werknemersverzekeringen.x-notes: NL: employer-borne premies werknemersverzekeringen (WW/WIA/ZW) over the wage (nl-werknemersverzekeringen-werkgever). Zero for a DGA (isDga true, dga-payroll-mode) -- see isDga.

isDga.title: Is dga
isDga.description: This employee was a director-major-shareholder when the payslip was calculated, so employee insurance contributions are zero by design.
isDga.x-notes: NL: denormalized copy of Employee.isDga at calculation time (dga-payroll-mode) -- true means this employee is a DGA (director-major-shareholder), not verzekeringsplichtig for the werknemersverzekeringen (Awf/Aof/Wko/Whk), so werknemersverzekeringen reads zero by design rather than by engine defect. loonheffing/volksverzekeringen/zvw/nettoPay are unaffected.

Included in nettoPay, folded AFTER retroAdjustment/leaveBuySell -- the beslagvrije voet protects the employee's actual take-home this period, never an intermediate figure. Null when deductionCents is 0 (no active Loonbeslag covers this period, or the employee already has no headroom above the voet). PayrollCalculator is never invoked for this figure -- entirely post-tax arithmetic in PayrollRunService.

LoonaangifteFiling.title: Wage Tax Filing
LoonaangifteFiling.description: A wage-tax / social-security filing for one wage period (NL loonaangifte / DE Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung & Beitragsnachweis / FR DSN / US Form 941 & deposits). Carries the period, deadline, submission, and tijdvak attributes the filing-window checks read. For NL, the filing also carries a declarative create->review->confirm->send lifecycle (concept -> klaargezet -> bevestigd -> verzonden) plus tijdvakcode/response-capture fields (loonaangifte-filing-lifecycle).

klaarzetten.description: Marks the filing as review-ready. Requires period, tijdvak, tijdvakcode and deadline to be present (schema-required plus the nl-loonaangifte-tijdvakcode / nl-loonaangifte-deadline-derivation checks).

bevestigen.description: Confirms the reviewed filing for dispatch to the Belastingdienst.

verzenden.description: Marks the filing as sent. submittedDate and verzondenDoor are stamped on the carrying write (the Timesheet approvedAt/approvedBy pattern); electronicallyFiled is set by the writer.

heropenen.description: Reopens a not-yet-sent filing for correction before it is confirmed or sent.

corrigeren.description: A sent filing can be superseded by a correction (NL allows correcties binnen het tijdvak). The usual route is a NEW filing object for the same period; this transition's reset-to-concept semantics are a simplified placeholder — full correctie-berichten (VL/IB-correcties) are a future spec.

period.title: Period
period.description: Wage period the filing covers, in YYYY-MM.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: Which country's rules this filing falls under.
jurisdiction.x-notes: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country governing this filing (NL/DE/FR/US).

filingType.title: Filing type
filingType.description: Filing kind: loonaangifte / lohnsteuer-anmeldung / beitragsnachweis / deuv-meldung / lohnsteuerbescheinigung / dsn / form-941 / form-940 / deposit / form-w2.

tijdvak.title: Filing period
tijdvak.description: How often you file: monthly, four-weekly, quarterly or yearly.
tijdvak.x-notes: Filing period type (tijdvak / Anmeldungszeitraum / deposit schedule) (nl-loonaangifte-tijdvak / de-lohnsteuer-anmeldungszeitraum / us-deposit-schedule-lookback).

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: The statutory deadline for filing and paying. In the Netherlands, the last working day of the month after the period.
deadline.x-notes: Statutory filing/payment deadline (ISO 8601). NL: last working day of the month after the period (nl-loonaangifte-termijn). DE: 10th of the following month (de-lohnsteuer-anmeldung). FR: 5th/15th (fr-dsn-echeance). US: last day of month after quarter (us-form-941-quarterly).

submittedDate.title: Submitted date
submittedDate.description: Date the filing was submitted electronically — must be on or before the deadline.

paidDate.title: Paid date
paidDate.description: Date the related contributions/taxes were paid.

electronicallyFiled.title: Electronically filed
electronicallyFiled.x-notes: Whether the filing was submitted electronically (nl-loonaangifte-tijdvak / de-lohnsteuer-anmeldung / fr-dsn-mensuelle / us-eftps-deposit).

priorYearLiability.title: Prior year liability
priorYearLiability.description: Germany: last year's wage tax, which decides how often you must file.
priorYearLiability.x-notes: DE: prior-year Lohnsteuer that determines the Anmeldungszeitraum thresholds (de-lohnsteuer-anmeldungszeitraum).

lookbackLiability.title: Lookback liability
lookbackLiability.description: United States: employment tax in the lookback period, which sets the deposit schedule.
lookbackLiability.x-notes: US: employment-tax liability in the lookback period that sets the deposit schedule (us-deposit-schedule-lookback).

depositSchedule.title: Deposit schedule
depositSchedule.description: United States: the federal deposit schedule that follows from the lookback liability.
depositSchedule.x-notes: US: federal deposit schedule derived from the lookback liability (us-deposit-monthly / us-deposit-semiweekly).

accumulatedLiability.title: Accumulated liability
accumulatedLiability.description: United States: accumulated employment tax, which triggers the next-day and FUTA deposit rules.
accumulatedLiability.x-notes: US: accumulated employment-tax liability driving the $100k next-day and $500 FUTA deposit rules (us-deposit-100k-next-day / us-futa-deposit-500).

nextDayDepositMade.title: Next day deposit made
nextDayDepositMade.description: United States: a next-business-day deposit was made after liability reached $100,000.
nextDayDepositMade.x-notes: US: whether a next-business-day deposit was made when liability reached $100k (us-deposit-100k-next-day).

eventSignalDays.title: Event signal days
eventSignalDays.description: France: working days taken to transmit an event notification — five at most.
eventSignalDays.x-notes: FR: working days taken to transmit an event signalement — must be ≤5 (fr-dsn-evenementielle).

furnishedToRecipientDate.title: Furnished to recipient date
furnishedToRecipientDate.description: United States / Germany: the date the year-end statement was given to the employee.
furnishedToRecipientDate.x-notes: US/DE: date the year-end statement (W-2 to employee, Lohnsteuerbescheinigung) was furnished (us-form-w2-to-employee / de-lohnsteuerbescheinigung).

filedWithAuthorityDate.title: Filed with authority date
filedWithAuthorityDate.description: United States: the date the W-2 transmittal was filed with the Social Security Administration.
filedWithAuthorityDate.x-notes: US: date Copy A / W-3 transmittal was filed with the SSA (us-form-w2-w3-to-ssa).

returnCountInYear.title: Return count in year
returnCountInYear.description: United States: how many information returns you filed this year. Ten or more means you must file electronically.
returnCountInYear.x-notes: US: aggregate information returns filed in the year, driving the 10-return e-file rule (us-w2-efile-threshold).

retainedUntil.title: Retained until
retainedUntil.description: How long the filing records must be kept: seven years in the Netherlands, six in Germany, four in the United States.
retainedUntil.x-notes: Date until which the filing records are retained (NL 7yr / DE 6yr / US 4yr).

status.title: Status
Status
status.description: Where this filing has got to: draft, prepared, confirmed or sent.
status.x-notes: NL filing lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (concept -> klaargezet -> bevestigd -> verzonden). DE/FR/US filings are unaffected by the lifecycle and stay at the default.

tijdvakcode.title: Filing period code
tijdvakcode.description: The official period code from the tax authority that matches this period and filing frequency.
tijdvakcode.x-notes: Official Belastingdienst numeric period code (Handboek Loonheffingen LH 210, 2026 edition), matching this filing's period + tijdvak (nl-loonaangifte-tijdvakcode). Maand: one code per calendar month (6010 = January 2026 .. 6120 = December 2026). Vierweken: thirteen four-weekly codes (6710, 6750, 6790, 6830, 6870, 6910, 6950, 6990, 7030, 7070, 7110, 7150, 7190 = periods 1-13). Jaar: 6400. The authoritative table is data, not hard-coded here — see the nl-loonaangifte-tijdvakcode rule's `parameters` in lib/Standards/rules/payroll.json; it is re-issued annually by the Belastingdienst alongside the Gegevensspecificaties, so a new year is a data-only change.

aangiftenummer.title: Filing number
aangiftenummer.description: The reference the tax authority uses for this filing — your payroll tax number plus the period code.
aangiftenummer.x-notes: Loonheffingennummer + tijdvakcode composite identifier the Belastingdienst uses to key this filing.

betalingskenmerk.title: Payment reference
betalingskenmerk.description: Payment reference the Belastingdienst issues for this filing period's remittance.

responseStatus.title: Response status
responseStatus.description: What the tax authority sent back. Correct a rejected filing with the 'corrigeren' action.
responseStatus.x-notes: Outcome of the Belastingdienst response to a sent filing. A rejected (afgekeurd) filing is corrected via the corrigeren transition; no automated polling/ingestion happens in this app.

responseMessage.title: Response message
responseMessage.description: What the tax authority wrote back: a confirmation, or the reason for rejection.
responseMessage.x-notes: Free-text Belastingdienst response message (acceptance note or rejection reason).

verzondenDoor.title: Sent by
verzondenDoor.x-notes: Display name of the person who sent the filing, stamped on the verzenden carrying write (the Timesheet approvedBy pattern).

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this filing is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun convention); an organisation-level filing has no employee/parent to derive it from, so nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema.

WkrDeclaration.title: WKR Declaration
WkrDeclaration.description: One recorded werkkostenregeling (WKR) vergoeding/verstrekking/terbeschikkingstelling for an administration (wkr-administration): a company-wide allowance/benefit (staff outing, Christmas hamper, fixed-cost allowance) or an employee-specific one, categorised so the administration-level vrije-ruimte roll-up (WkrService) knows whether it consumes the vrije ruimte, stays outside it as a gerichte vrijstelling, or was already designated eindheffingsloon.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: Which administration this declaration belongs to.
administrationId.x-notes: The administration this declaration belongs to (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-001). Plain string, not a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun convention -- no Administration schema is modeled in humaniq).

year.title: Year
year.description: The tax year this counts towards — the work-related costs budget is a whole-year budget.
year.x-notes: Fiscal year this declaration counts toward -- the vrije ruimte is a whole-year budget (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-001).

date.title: Date
date.description: Date the allowance/benefit was granted, invoiced, or made available.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the allowance was for, for example 'Personeelsuitje juni'.
description.x-notes: Free-text description of the vergoeding/verstrekking (e.g. "Personeelsuitje juni").

wkrCategory.title: WKR category
wkrCategory.description: How this allowance is treated: charged to the free margin, specifically exempt, or already taxed as a final levy.
wkrCategory.x-notes: WKR classification (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-001, design.md D1): `vrije-ruimte` consumes the administration's vrije ruimte; `gericht-vrijgesteld` is a statutory gerichte vrijstelling that stays outside it (nl-wkr-gerichte-vrijstelling, judgemental, unchanged by this schema); `eindheffing` is loon the employer already designated as eindheffingsloon. Only `vrije-ruimte` amounts are summed into vrijeRuimteUsed.

employeeId.title: Employee ID
employeeId.description: The employee this concerns. Leave empty for a company-wide allowance.
employeeId.x-notes: The employee this declaration concerns, or null for a collective/company-wide allowance (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-001).

sourceReference.title: Source reference
sourceReference.description: Invoice/journal reference for the audit trail (e.g. "INV-2026-0612").

WkrAssessment.title: WKR Assessment
WkrAssessment.description: The per-(administrationId, year) computed vrije-ruimte/eindheffing summary AND the reporting record (wkr-administration, the PayrollMutationReport precedent): produced ONLY by WkrService::assess(), rolling the cross-object fiscale loonsom (Σ Payslip.grossPay) and the administration's WkrDeclarations into the available vrije ruimte, the used amount, the excess and the 80% eindheffing exposure. Idempotently keyed on (administrationId, year): recomputing upserts this record in place, never duplicates. Persisting the assessment as a real object (rather than a transient calculation) is what makes nl-wkr-eindheffing-exposure RuleEngine-reachable -- the standing audit loads every WkrAssessment and checks it automatically.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.x-notes: The administration this assessment covers (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-003). Idempotent key together with year -- plain string, not a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun convention).

year.title: Year
year.description: The tax year this assessment covers.
year.x-notes: The fiscal year this assessment covers (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-003).

fiscaleLoonsom.title: Taxable wage bill
fiscaleLoonsom.description: Total gross pay across this administration and year, used to work out the free margin.
fiscaleLoonsom.x-notes: Σ Payslip.grossPay over this administration/year -- the fiscale-loonsom proxy WkrService reads (design.md Risks: an honest, auditable proxy for the exact kolom-14 loonsom, never a recomputed payroll figure).

vrijeRuimte.title: Free margin
vrijeRuimte.description: The free margin available, derived from the total wage bill.
vrijeRuimte.x-notes: Available vrije ruimte, computed from fiscaleLoonsom against the `wkr` group tranche percentages/grens in the active tax-year table (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-002).

vrijeRuimteUsed.title: Free margin used
vrijeRuimteUsed.description: Everything charged to the free margin this year: allowances on payslips plus separately declared ones.
vrijeRuimteUsed.x-notes: Σ Payslip.wkrUsed + Σ WkrDeclaration.amount where wkrCategory = 'vrije-ruimte', for this administration/year.

vrijeRuimteRemaining.title: Free margin remaining
vrijeRuimteRemaining.description: What is left of the free margin, never below zero.

excess.title: Excess
excess.description: How far the free margin was exceeded. Zero when it was not. This is the amount the 80% final levy applies to.
excess.x-notes: vrijeRuimteUsed minus vrijeRuimte when positive, else 0 -- the amount subject to the 80% eindheffing.

eindheffingRate.title: Final levy rate
eindheffingRate.description: The final levy rate applied to the excess — 80. Empty when there is no excess.
eindheffingRate.x-notes: The eindheffing rate (80, from the `wkr` table group) applied to the excess; null when excess is 0 (nl-wkr-eindheffing-exposure).

eindheffingDue.title: Final levy due
eindheffingDue.description: The final levy owed over the amount above the free margin.
eindheffingDue.x-notes: 80% of excess, rounded to the cent -- the eindheffing the employer owes over the vrije-ruimte overrun (settlement itself is a named fast-follow, not automated by this schema).

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether this administration stayed within its free margin, or owes a final levy on the excess.
status.x-notes: Whether the administration/year stayed within its vrije ruimte, or an eindheffing is owed over the excess (wkr-administration REQ-WKR-003/-WKR-004).

engineVersion.title: Engine version
engineVersion.description: The tables id (e.g. "nl-2026") this assessment's vrije-ruimte/eindheffing figures were computed against.

assessedAt.title: Assessed at
assessedAt.description: When this assessment was last calculated.
assessedAt.x-notes: When this assessment was (re)computed by WkrService::assess().
